## What's new

Threadnote 4.6.12 resolves nine reported dependency vulnerabilities and updates to Effect 4 RC 115 and Bun 1.4.2.

### Security updates

The release includes patched versions of `qs`, `fast-uri`, and `hono`. No user action is needed beyond updating Threadnote.

### Effect update

Effect 4 RC 115 includes the upstream fix for read-only SQLite transactions. Bun 1.4.2 fixes the SQLite statement-cache lifetime issue, allowing Threadnote to remove its local Effect patch. The runtime and test integrations are updated together.
